phrases.latin: Foriculīs apertīs, ē fenestrā per tenebrās arborēs et suprā eās lūmina illa longō ōrdine dīrēcta cernēbantur
phrases.english: With the shutters open, the trees could be seen from the window in the dark, and above them those lights in a long straight row

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 124, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
